scope: Windows portable exact-once verification argv correction; preserve all tests, offline guard, source checks and strict selection.
riskAnalysis: Verification control changes are critical: false-low classification or stale evidence could omit mandatory security tests. Default unknown/shared/executable/dependency changes to STRICT; preserve owner preflight and independent acceptance.

threatModel.assets: Mandatory security/contract tests, source/release identity, immutable evidence, owner authority and historical budget accounting.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Actual Git history to lane selection; source-derived plan to CI jobs; protected Preview identity to browser scope; recorded checkpoint to resumed agent.
threatModel.abuseCases: Disguised dependency, renamed/deleted protected source, active CSS/HTML, stale plan, mutated source during test, skipped security scan labelled passed, or old authority observation treated as permission.
threatModel.mitigations: Complete no-renames diff, canonical paths/modes, both-tree protected-consumer checks, conservative active-content rejection, exact head/tree before and after execution, explicit scope labels, immutable release pin, no evidence-cache permissions.

rollback: Keep paid false. Revert only verification optimization on feature branch if gates fail; preserve full default npm test/live preflight and all historical evidence. Never change Production or authorization.

defects.rootCause: New full union passed364 absolute source paths totaling54872characters to Windows process creation, exceeding its command-line capacity.
defects.detectionGap: Small targeted sets passed; whole-suite process creation was not tested until the first actual strict run. That run stopped before any tests.
defects.regression: Actual complete current filename set uses unique canonical relative paths under24000characters; harmless process with same file arguments exits0; unsafe/duplicate/oversized sets reject before process creation.
defects.historicalPrevention: Preserved actualabsolute ENAMETOOLONG probe has0tests; new regression exercises whole-set process creation and catches the prior absolute argv failure without costly suite repetition.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing quality gate and contract list remain authoritative; one selector/runner and lightweight affected public checker, no parallel agent executor.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Node builtins and already pinned Playwright; no new packages, credentials, paid transport or customer mutations.
proactiveReview.threats: Low-risk concealment, escaped CSS, entity/active HTML, missing history, stale source, mismatched deployment, unsafe header forwarding and misleading cached evidence.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Selection errors stop rather than downgrade; source changes during tests reject evidence; manual Browser reruns force STRICT; failure artifacts preserved.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual temporary Git histories, both-tree consumers, rename/delete/modes, altered plans, executable/dependency content, false authority and workflow gating.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate QA authored adversarial tests; Auditor identified CSS/HTML escapes, manual dispatch base, end-of-run source drift and metadata false positives; corrections independently reviewed.
proactiveReview.recovery: Concise source-bound recovery pointer with exact next action and observation age; no new authorization window; revert feature verification changes safely.
proactiveReview.readiness: Full optimization change itself is STRICT; run frozen full union, independent reviews, Redis/CI/CodeQL and exact hosted full Browser QA, then measure docs identity-only lane. Affected lane remains separately qualified.
